mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_review (order_id, user_id, service_id, servicer_id, rating, content, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{serviceId}, #{servicerId}, #{rating}, IFNULL(#{content}, ''), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, service_id, servicer_id, rating, content, create_time FROM t_review WHERE service_id = #{serviceId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
